newsitem.title: USA: Pa. economic activity index up 0.2 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Pa. economic activity index up 0.2 pct in October.

text.p: Pennsylvania's Economic Activity Index rose 0.2 percent in October, the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Tuesday.
An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate outweighed a decrease in hours worked, the bank said.
For the 12 months ending in October, Pennsylvania's index was up 1.4 percent.
The national Index of Coincident Indicators compiled by the Conference Board fell 0.1 percent in October and was up three percent over the last 12 months.

The Economic Activity Index for Pennsylvania is constructed from data on payroll employment, average hours worked in manufacturing, the unemployment rate, and retail sales. All data are seasonally adjusted by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia.
